purpose: Define the separately authorized, query-only Docker Desktop startup and runtime-inventory probe required before central admission of the current-host WSL2 Linux-container candidate.
declared_startup_effects: start the already installed Docker Desktop application and its WSL2 docker-desktop backend
create or append Docker Desktop and WSL runtime logs and normal transient runtime state
start local services and named pipes required by the existing installation
Docker Desktop may perform vendor update, telemetry, entitlement or sign-in checks unless disabled by existing settings; no claim of zero startup network is allowed without connection evidence
stop Docker Desktop after the probe and record whether docker-desktop returns to Stopped
allowed_probe_surfaces: Docker Desktop application, CLI and daemon versions
desktop-linux context endpoint and daemon reachability
server OS, architecture, kernel, containerd and storage-driver identities
server security options, cgroup version and root directory
installed runtime declarations including NVIDIA exposure without running a container
image and container cardinalities and immutable IDs already present
declared proxy and registry configuration with credentials and secret values redacted
WSL distro state before start, during probe and after stop
C and E free-space observations before and after
prohibited_probe_actions: docker pull, build, create, run, exec, commit, import, load, tag, push, login, logout, rm, rmi, prune or system prune
Docker Desktop update, reset, factory reset, sign-in, settings edit or engine switch
WSL install, import, export, update, terminate, unregister, set-default or configuration edit
image, source, package, dataset or checkpoint acquisition
mounting E drive or any project path into a container
materialization, preprocessing, training, evaluation, benchmark or TEST access
automatic retry after a failed start or query

before: Docker Desktop stopped and desktop-linux endpoint unavailable
exact Docker Desktop executable path, version, byte size and SHA-256
exact WSL, kernel and Windows build identities
during: one startup attempt with timestamps and exit status
daemon version and info output with secret-bearing fields redacted
context, image, container, system-df and runtime inventory
startup connection evidence if available without adding a tracing driver or changing firewall policy
after: one stop attempt if startup succeeded
daemon endpoint unavailable and docker-desktop distro stopped, or an explicit residual-state failure
exact stdout and stderr hashes for every query
declaration that no prohibited Docker command was issued

admission_checks_after_probe: backend is Linux on amd64 and bound to desktop-linux
runtime identities are complete enough to pin a future image and runner
current disk headroom is at least 20 GiB on C and 50 GiB on E before any image acquisition proposal
no hidden running container or image mutation occurred during the probe
no credential value is persisted into research artifacts
standard WSL2 security limitations remain disclosed
a no-network offline execution command can be designed with --network none and --pull never
Windows attempt-003 packet is explicitly superseded for this lane rather than silently translated
required_user_decision: Explicitly authorize one Docker Desktop start, query-only probe, and stop-after-probe with the declared local-log and possible vendor-control-network effects. This authorization cannot be inferred from the earlier read-only PC2W preflight.
